meta.title: Reading and influences
meta.note: The order of these links changes from time to time. That is intentional. Learning is rarely linear, and neither is change.

tiers.label: Start here
tiers.microCopy: A way in, not a conclusion.

items.name: Government Digital Service Manual
items.annotation: Clear, practical guidance grounded in real delivery inside complex public systems.

items.name: Nesta
items.annotation: Systems-focused innovation work with a consistent public value lens.

items.name: Institute for Government
items.annotation: Evidence-led analysis of how government actually functions, including its constraints.

items.name: London Review of Books
items.annotation: Long-form essays that model careful thinking, scepticism, and intellectual restraint.

tiers.label: Go deeper
tiers.microCopy: When the simple explanations stop working.

items.name: MIT Sloan Management Review (selected open articles)
items.annotation: Thoughtful analysis of organisational change and learning, with a growing open-access archive.

items.name: Oxford Review
items.annotation: Consistently critical, evidence-based writing on leadership and organisational decision-making.

items.name: Academy of Management Annals (open summaries)
items.annotation: High-quality synthesis of management research, useful even when full papers are gated.

items.name: Behavioural Insights Team Blog
items.annotation: Applied behavioural science with transparency about limits, context, and evidence.

tiers.microCopy: This may change how you see the problem.
